dct_description_sm: The Wildlife Research section conducts scientific research and wildlife monitoring programs involving the collection, analysis, application and archiving of both scientific data and Inuit knowledge related to wildlife. Development of management plans, regulations, and conservation recommendations for consideration by the Nunavut Wildlife Management Board (NWMB) are achieved through extensive community and stakeholder consultation
dct_title_s: Kitikmeot monitoring program: mammals and vegetation (Dept. of Environment Monitoring Program, Government of Nunavut)
